text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Total renovation is more effective from the point of view of energy efficiency.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "The aim here is to encourage total renovation instead of partial renovation, which until now has been more attractive in fiscal terms."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Entro la fine del 2020, le automobili di nuova immatricolazione dovranno emettere mediamente solo 95 g CO2/km.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Prescrizioni in materia di emissioni per autoveicoli"}, {"side": "en", "quote": "As a consequence, the accepted limit for CO2/km emissions for all new passenger vehicles on the road will be reduced to an average of 95g CO2/km by the end of 2020.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Under the Energy Strategy 2050, current emissions specifications will be tightened."}]}
